readings.Aries: You are not too much. You are, however, misdirected. Adjust the trajectory. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Taurus: The disagreement is not about the thing. It is about who gets to decide. Know which battle you're having. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Gemini: Not every thought needs to be shared. Some of them are just thoughts. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Cancer: Your history is rich and present in everything you do. It is also, in some places, instructing you incorrectly. Let this one be easy.
readings.Leo: The dignity you carry is real and sometimes it makes you harder to reach. Lower the threshold slightly. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Virgo: The flaw you keep returning to is not the problem. The returning is the problem. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Libra: You are allowed to have a preference. Having one does not make you unfair. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Scorpio: What you've buried hasn't decomposed. It has been waiting. Time to deal with it. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Sagittarius: The thing you've been treating as small talk was actually a significant conversation. Revisit it. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Capricorn: Someone you respect is watching and taking notes. Good. You know what you're doing. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Aquarius: Something you built to be useful has become something you're attached to. Worth knowing. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Pisces: Something you believed in has faded. The fading is not failure — it is information about what you actually believe. The energy available today is better used gently.

sky_notes: Mercury appears retrograde today. Earth isn't overtaking Mercury — Mercury is lapping us on the inside track, so it appears to drift backwards against the stars. Your western blot is unaffected.
Venus appears retrograde today. Venus is passing between us and the Sun, so it appears to slide backwards for ~6 weeks. Gravity on your bench is unchanged.
Saturn appears retrograde today. Earth is overtaking Saturn — an apparent backwards loop that happens every year for ~4.5 months. Plan your timecourse accordingly (or don't).
Uranus appears retrograde today. Uranus spends ~5 months of every year appearing to go backwards because Earth laps it. It's tilted 98°, so it's used to looking odd.
Neptune appears retrograde today. Neptune appears retrograde ~5 months a year as Earth laps it. Light from Neptune takes ~4 hours to reach you, so this news is already old.
Waxing crescent: we see a growing sliver of the Moon's sunlit half as it moves ~12° further east of the Sun each day.
Mars and Jupiter are within 0.8° of each other in the sky — a line-of-sight coincidence; in reality they are hundreds of millions of km apart.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: geocentric, from JPL Keplerian elements (Standish, valid 1800–2050) + Meeus ch.25/47 for Sun & Moon; checked against PyEphem to within 0.5°
Positions are for ~midday Sydney time on the stated date (tropical zodiac, equinox of date)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
